facts.text: Is a member of the MAC-HA Exploration Project team in the Tulum region of Quintana Roo, Mexico, which since Jul 2026 has expanded from three initial water openings to 11 known cenotes and approximately 1,370 m (4,500 ft) of explored flooded passage

Participated in the 20km Royal Danish Air Force Ruck March at Hancock Field Air National Guard Base in Syracuse, New York, on Aug 29, 2026, as a human resources technician assigned to the 27th Infantry Brigade Combat Team

Participated in the 20km Royal Danish Air Force Ruck March at Hancock Field Air National Guard Base in Syracuse, New York, on Aug 29, 2026, as the 27th Infantry Brigade Combat Team's human resources noncommissioned officer in charge
Released a new version of 'The Silence' featuring Ben Fuller, Jan 9, 2026
Released the 'Heavy Things' EP, featuring Colin Caldwell, Jun 26, 2026

Co-authored 'Association Between Leg Muscle Coordination and Subjective Energy-Fatigue States During Walking', published in Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise, Oct 2025

Co-authored the report on the 2025 field campaign at Susani – Grămurada de la Jupani in Romania, published in Ziridava. Studia Archaeologica 39 (2025), covering the Jun 23 to Aug 1, 2025 excavation of a two-room sunken structure used for cremated remains and ritual activity

note: Extra round (JD-directed, run the same day as the AM round). Checked 50 people, weighted toward Guard members, current students and athletes, Lewis School colleagues, and local business owners from the least-recently-checked pool, and filed 15 bullets across 10 people, each parent-verified on its source page and read back in the Sheet exactly once. Fresh sweep: none found — a dedicated sweep of items published Oct 19 to Nov 9 across NCPR, North Country Now, NNY360, WWNY, ClickNNY, the four colleges' news and athletics, and the health systems found nothing new for a directory member beyond what earlier runs filed; the one borderline item, SUNY Canton President Zvi Szafran's Nov 5 scholarship-drive quote, is a mention in his long-known role and was logged, not filed. Emily Criscitello is on the MAC-HA Exploration Project team in Tulum, whose explored passage has grown to about 1,370 m across 11 cenotes since Jul 2026. CW2 Ryan Blount and Master Sgt. Samantha Antolik both took part in the Aug 29, 2026 Royal Danish Air Force Ruck March at Hancock Field (DVIDS, posted Oct 16, 2026). Jon Cyphers released three records in 2026: a new version of 'The Silence' with Ben Fuller, the 'Heavy Things' EP, and the single 'Closer Than A Friend'. Sarah Haller's SUNY Potsdam degree is now on file (Bachelor of Arts, Environmental Studies, May 2023), as is Susan Buckley's M.Ed. from SUNY Potsdam and her promotion to senior investigator in the New York State Police. Alisha Ohl co-authored the OT-SECC validation study in the American Journal of Occupational Therapy (Nov 2025), Kwadwo Appiah-Kubi co-authored two October 2025 papers in Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise, Ria Amo serves as her pharmacy college's ACCP student liaison, and Robin DiPasquale co-authored the 2025 Susani field-campaign report in Ziridava. 5 candidates added to Research Command (ledger 569): identity holds for Elise Deuel, Murray, Lael Card, and Alisha Ohl, and a close call for Mark C Walczyk (his district's full county list, from the same filed re-election report). 64 of JD's console 'file' decision points were pending reconciliation into changes.json. Logged, not filed: Patrick Murphy's Clarkson ROTC item (Instagram only, no verbatim caption could be captured), Ria Amo's Instagram chapter-president claims (social only), and Mark Walczyk's energy and budget quotes from the already-filed report. Unharvested photo leads flagged by JD in Research Command, awaiting a photo pass: Christine Sutter (UConn Today); Emily Criscitello (Tulum dive operator); Joann Duclos (Army.mil); Joe Charlebois (Hockey records); Katelyn Tomford (Zola); Kayla Hettel (Puget Sound Birth Center); Max Ferran (Bold.org); Megan Converse (Merit Pages).
